coverage.summary: Applies citywide to residential rental property in the City of San Diego. It reaches anyone who sells, licenses or otherwise provides algorithmic devices to landlords, and landlords who use such devices to set rental rates or occupancy levels. No unit-count, construction-date or owner-type limits are stated.
coverage.other_conditions: Residential rental property has the meaning in SDMC § 98.0702: any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobilehome park.

result.notes: I removed the summary's reference to the state Cartwright Act (Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729) because no document in the set supports it. I also dropped the claim that the Division borrows only the § 98.0702 definitions and not the Division 7 exemptions, and moved it here as an inference. Division 11 incorporates § 98.0702 definitions only. The § 98.0703 exemptions state that 'This Division shall not apply', which refers to Division 7, so they do not appear to carry over. The software exclusions (aged or public data reports, affordable-housing program software, appraisal software) define the regulated device. They are not building or unit exemptions, so unverifiable_exemptions stays empty. requires_unknown_facts is false because the rule covers ordinary residential rental property.
